_note: Strings for named_guests.py. Cues are regexes over the lowercased utterance with ?!.,;: dropped and a leading 'hey zoe' stripped; they must match the WHOLE utterance and capture the guest's spoken first name as (?P<name>...). A cue only ROUTES a turn. 'script' overrides the member enrolment script (voice_enrollment_en.json) for a guest's run; {name} is the guest.

say.start: Okay. {name}, stay by the panel and I'll ask you to say a few short phrases. I keep a voice signature, not recordings.
say.start_fail: I couldn't reach the panel speaker just now, so I haven't started. Try again in a minute.
say.is_member: {name} has their own account here, so they can say learn my voice themselves.
say.no_panel: I can only learn a voice at the panel, with them standing next to it.
say.unverified: I'm not sure who's asking, so I can't do that. Sign in with your PIN first and ask me again.
say.guest_cannot: Only someone who lives here can ask me to learn or forget a guest's voice.
say.minor_cannot: That's one for a grown-up in the house to ask me.
say.forget_done: Done. I've forgotten {name}'s voice and our conversations.
say.forget_none: I don't know a voice for {name}.
say.forget_fail: Something went wrong and I couldn't forget {name}'s voice just now. Please ask me again.

script.done: Thanks, {name}. I'll know your voice now.
script.partial: Thanks, {name}. I only saved part of it, but I can already use it.
